CustomObject.description: Approval settings (build 49). Org default row: whether approving a release into the production hub needs the Production Approver add-on (custom permission RLY_Prod_Approver). Off by default so a hub upgraded with existing approvers isn't locked out; a new hub turns it on when its first Git connection is saved. Read and written only by RlyProdApproval; admins change it on the Pipeline tab.
CustomObject.label: RLY Approval Setting
